messages.subject: activityOverlap plot legend size
parts:
Hello,

I have this issue when I run the activityOverlap function. I have been searching and trying without success. Is there a way to change the plot legend size?

My code
graf1 <- activityOverlap (recordTable = recordTableSample,
                 speciesA    = civet,
                 speciesB    = leopardcat,
                 writePNG    = FALSE,
                 plotR       = TRUE,
                 add.rug     = TRUE,
                 legendPosition = "topleft",
                 )

Thanks,

Raquel

messages.author: 0b86ca0cb4b615b0
messages.subject: Re: [camtrapR] activityOverlap plot legend size
parts:
Hi Raquel, 
this is currently not directly possible. While you can pass additional arguments to activityOverlap() in "...", these are passed to overlapPlot(), which in turn passes them to plot(). That doesn't help with the legend, which is created independentlyof plot() with legend().

Here are a few potential workarounds: 
  • increase pngWidth and pngHeight
  • in the RStudio plot window, change the size of the window and it will change the look of the figure also. Then export from there. 
  • modify the code of the function here, around line 227 and/or 254. 
  • use the output of activityOverlap (a data frame with time and density values of both species) and make your own plot in base R or ggplot2, with full control over the legend
In the long run I'd like to port these function to ggplot if I find the time, but haven't yet managed to. 
Best regards,
Jürgen
